name: Choirfoot
descriptionSeed: The Seraphic Orders receive every arrival from below, deliberately. Choirfoot is where you are seen before you are admitted: the choir sings, the sisters watch who flinches, and a mercy-reader comes down the stair to ask what you have come for. You may go up. You will be looked at first.
appearance: A walled court at the foot of the lowest spire, paved in white and open to the sky, the gate arch at its centre. Choristers sing the hours from a gallery above it, and every arrival hears them before anything else.
encounterFlavor: A sister kneeling to wash the feet of a carter who did not ask; a chorister stopping mid-phrase when an armed band steps through; the gallery going silent, all at once, because something came through the gate that the hymn did not know.
